description: Averages the two semiannual testing dates and, if the fund falls short, computes the Form 8996 Part IV penalty month by month (pass month-end figures in monthly for an exact figure; otherwise testing-date figures are applied to each half-year and the result is flagged as an approximation) at an underpayment rate the caller supplies.

monthly.description: Optional month-end figures for Form 8996 Part IV: [{total, qozp, rate_pct}]

months.description: Months the entity was a QOF this year, 1-12 (default 12)

single_date.description: true if only the year-end test applies (first year under 6 months); otherwise d1_* are required

underpayment_rate_pct.description: IRS underpayment rate for the period, percent

name: calc_90_percent_test
title: QOF 90% asset test
